name: Low-Light Video Super-Resolution Benchmark (LLVSR)
description: "We introduce the Low-Light Video Super-Resolution Benchmark (LLVSR), a new benchmark with a detailed production pipeline for the field of Low-Light Video Super-Resolution (LLVSR). It includes \u00d72 and \u00d74 scaling factors, totaling 54,000 paired low-resolution and high-resolution video sequences, named LLLR-Video. The benchmark covers diverse real-world scenes and complex degradation conditions, such as insufficient illumination, noise, and motion blur. Unlike existing datasets that mainly focus on synthetic or static low-light settings, LLLR-Video emphasizes dynamic video scenarios with temporally varying illumination and realistic sensor noise. By providing standardized training\/testing splits and evaluation metrics, LLLR-Video offers a reproducible platform for fair comparison. We believe this benchmark will facilitate the development and assessment of low-light video super-resolution algorithms, and promote progress toward practical deployment in challenging environments such as nighttime surveillance and autonomous driving."
